firma.tel_passo1: MB Visual copies the document to the exchange folder below (OneDrive).
firma.tel_passo2: On the phone, open the file from the OneDrive (or Files) app and share it with CieSign or your certification authority's app.
firma.tel_passo3: Sign it (with the ID card: PIN and card held against the phone).
firma.tel_passo4: Save the signed file to the same OneDrive folder: MB Visual finds it, checks it and saves it next to the original.
firma.tel_valore: With the Italian ID card the signature is an advanced electronic signature (AdES): valid for most documents, but not where the law requires a qualified signature (e.g. real estate deeds, tenders, Business Register).
firma.tipo_annidata_nota: Signs the whole envelope: a countersignature that includes the previous signatures.
firma.tipo_p7m_nota: The format required by public administrations, tenders and certified e-mail.

firma.tipo_p7s_nota: The file stays as it is; the signature is in a file next to it with the same name + .p7s.
firma.tipo_pades_nota: The document stays a PDF that opens anywhere. More signatures can be added later.
firma.tipo_parallela_nota: The new signer is added to the same envelope, next to the existing ones.
firma.tsa_esempio: e.g. your certification authority's timestamp service
firma.tsa_nota: Qualified timestamps are sold by the certification authority with a user name and password. The password stays on the PC, encrypted by Windows.
firma.uscita_uguale: The signed file must have a different name from the original
